name: Cunningham Hill Open Space Playground
description: Playground at Cunningham Hill Open Space (Cunningham Field) with swings, a slide, a ground-level trampoline, a carousel and a seesaw. A path loops round the field, and there are benches, football pitches and a pavilion. Near the Cell Barnes Lane shops and the Alban Way.
operator: St Albans City and District Council
